name: Pirate Ship
desc: A pirate galleon under way — billowing tattered sails on three masts, a jolly-roger skull-and-crossbones flag streaming from the maintop, gunports puffing cannon smoke, rigging lines, a breathing stern lantern, and bow spray as it heaves on incommensurate swells. Styles: weathered pirate galleon, royal navy blue-and-gold, glowing ghost ship, SUNKEN wreck listing on the seabed with bubbles and a passing fish (perfect for underwater scenes), and a bathtub toy boat.
